Class ScenarioRepository

java.lang.Object
repositories.ScenarioRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ScenarioRepository extends Object implements Serializable
The ScenarioRepository class provides functionality to manage a collection of Scenario objects. It allows adding, validating, retrieving, and checking the existence of scenarios by their names.

  • Constructor Details

    • ScenarioRepository

      public ScenarioRepository()
      Constructs a new instance of the ScenarioRepository class. This constructor initializes an internal list for storing scenarios.

      The repository is designed to manage a collection of scenarios, providing functionalities such as adding new scenarios, retrieving scenarios, validating scenarios, and checking for the existence of a scenario by name.

  • Method Details

    • add

      public void add(Scenario scenario)
      Adds a scenario to the repository if it passes validation. This method validates the provided scenario using the validateScenario method and, if valid, adds it to the internal list of scenarios.
      Parameters:
      scenario - The scenario to be added to the repository. Must not be null and must pass validation.

    • existsByName

      public boolean existsByName(String name)
      Checks if a scenario with the specified name exists in the repository. This method iterates through the stored scenarios and compares their names (case-insensitively) with the provided name.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the scenario to check. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      true if a scenario with the specified name exists in the repository; false otherwise.

    • getScenarioList

      public List<Scenario> getScenarioList()
      Retrieves an unmodifiable list of all stored scenarios in the repository.

      This method returns a copy of the internal collection of scenarios, ensuring that the returned list cannot be modified by the caller.

      Returns:
      An unmodifiable List of Scenario objects representing all scenarios currently stored in the repository.

    • getScenarioListByMap

      public List<Scenario> getScenarioListByMap(Map map)

    • getScenarios

      public Optional<Scenario> getScenarios(String name)
      Retrieves an optional scenario from the repository based on its name. This method filters the internal list of scenarios by comparing their names to the specified name and returns the first match if available.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the scenario to retrieve. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the matching Scenario if a scenario with the specified name exists; otherwise, an empty Optional.
